_doc: Lighting moods (docs/adr/0003 pass 4, docs/adr/0005). In game the environment director (UMREnvironmentSubsystem) blends moods by the game hour along a zone's cycle ("cycles", "zones") and moves the sun and moon ("sky"); in the editor tools/ue/zone_mood.py bakes one mood ("levels") into L_World. Both apply a mood to the lighting actors build_world.py spawns in L_World, by actor label (a tag in game). Each actor block sets `rotation` ([pitch, yaw], directional light only) and properties on its main component; `settings` on GlobalPostProcess sets PostProcessSettings fields and turns their override flags on. Values: numbers, bools, [r,g,b(,a)] for colours/vectors, strings for enums. Exposure is in EV100 (r.DefaultFeature.AutoExposure.ExtendDefaultLuminanceRange); with the sun at ~8 lux the town sits around EV -1..1, so clamping above that blackens the shade. "Collection": values for MPC_Environment (WindowGlow: how brightly the painted windows glow, 0 by day; Stars: the night sky's stars, 0 by day, 1 at night).

sky._doc: The directional light's path (UMREnvironmentSubsystem, docs/adr/0005): the sun by day, the moon by night. Each rises in the east-north-east, is highest in the south halfway between rise and set, and sets in the west-north-west; game hours. The sun peaks at 14, where the original server's brightness peaks (kod SysRecalcLightAndDayPhase), and is in the south-west at 17 as the tuned afternoon mood. The moon is up from 18 to 10 the next day, highest at 2; moon_intensity (lux) and moon_temperature replace the moods' Sun values while the sun is down. The moods' Sun rotation is ignored except when one mood is pinned (-MRMood, mood_test.ps1).

cycles._doc: Day/night cycles: [game hour, mood] keys. The environment director blends the two keys around the hour (numbers and colours interpolate, everything else switches halfway), wrapping over midnight. The original's phases: night before 6 and after 20, dawn 6-8, day 9-17, dusk 18-20 (kod).

raza_outdoor._doc: Raza and the Outskirts: night until 4:30, the misty morning by 6:30, day (the afternoon mood) from 9:30 to 17, dusk by 19:30, night again from 21:30.

raza_interior._doc: Raza's buildings: lit by their own lights, with daylight through the painted windows from dawn to dusk (the original: dawn 6-8, dusk 18-20).

raza_crypt._doc: The Mausoleum: no daylight (the original's outside factor 0), the same at every hour.

zones._doc: Per zone (original room id) environment profile. cycle: which cycle it follows. kind: outdoor (default), interior or underground. sun: false turns the sun and moon off while the view is in the zone (interiors are closed boxes, but their single-sided walls and ceilings don't stop the sun's shadows). daylight: scales the moods' WindowDaylight (painted windows lit from outside by day): the original's outside factor / 10 (kod: 10 the Inn, 5 shops and the Hall, 3 the bank and vault, 0 underground). lamps: "always" keeps night-only lamps lit (the original's indoor lamps with outside factor 0). base_light, outside: the original room's base light (0-255) and outside factor (0-10) from data/zones.json; the director scales the moods' SectorAmbient by the original's room light, base + outside * (brightness - 50) / 4 (kod room.kod GetRoomLight), so rooms with windows dim at night. "default" covers every zone not listed. weather_zone: the original's weather zone (kod WEATHER_ZONE_*: Raza and its forest 13, Marion 4; 0 none, as the Mausoleum), whose storms the server rolls (AMRGameState). weather_mask: what a storm brings by season (kod WEATHER_MASK_* without the prefix: DEFAULT_NS is Raza's, rain in spring, summer and fall, snow in winter). Both fall back to "default". ambient: which ambient particles show here and how many ({kind: weight}; kinds in "atmosphere" "ambient"), also falling back to "default": Raza outdoors has pollen and fireflies, the forest also leaves, the buildings dust motes.

atmosphere._doc: Phase 5 (docs/adr/0005; UMREnvironmentSubsystem::AtmosphereFor). night_deg: the sun's elevation (degrees) below which it's full night and above which full day (MPC_Environment.Night: fireflies, moths, smoke). seasons: tint per season [spring, summer, fall, winter] on foliage and grass (materials.json "seasons"; summer is the original), and winter_snow_cover, snow that lies outdoors all winter where winter storms bring snow (0: off; 0.12, an even dusting, read as pale sand in look-dev p5b_winter_17; the original has none; keep below the pond's 0.15 so it doesn't ice over without a storm). smoke: how thickly the chimneys smoke (0..1): base, plus morning over morning_hours [rising from, full, full until, gone by], plus night x Night, plus winter; times 1 - storm x the storm. ambient: per kind, the share by season [spring, summer, fall, winter], when (day, night, always) and storm (the share a full storm takes away outdoors; negative brings more); the zone profiles' "ambient" say which kinds show where. The look of each (sizes, colours, counts): materials.json "atmosphere".

weather._doc: Weather (docs/adr/0005 phase 4). The server rolls a storm per weather zone each game day (15%, kod settings.kod piStormChance; AMRGameState). On the client a storm builds over build_seconds and clears over clear_seconds; the zone's state blends toward the overlay mood in "storm" for its kind (rain or snow by season and the zone's weather_mask; "interior" for buildings, which only lose window daylight). Overlay moods name only what changes: a number or array replaces, {"mul": x} multiplies and {"add": x} adds (per component for arrays; the base mood must have the field, so it blends back when the storm clears), and "CloudMaterial" sets the clouds' material parameters. Outdoors the ground gets wet over wet_seconds and dries over dry_seconds (MPC_Environment.Wetness), or white over snow_seconds and melts over melt_seconds (SnowCover); the wind (MPC Wind) goes from wind_clear to wind_storm. Rainstorms bring lightning every min_seconds..max_seconds: the "Lightning" light flashes to lux outdoors, and the windows by window_flash inside.

sounds._doc: The original client's sounds (resource/<name>.ogg), imported by build_world.py: rain and wind loop with the storm (muffled inside), thunder follows each lightning stroke. follow_mask: true plays them only where the zone's weather_mask has the sound bit, as the original did (Raza's DEFAULT_NS has none: its rain was silent); false plays them everywhere a storm is.

storm_rain._doc: Overlay for a rainstorm (blended in by the storm's strength): overcast - the sun mostly gone, a dimmer sky, thick low clouds - grey rain haze close in, colours washed out, and an exposure that keeps the storm dark.

storm_snow._doc: Overlay for a snowstorm: a white, flat light - the sun dimmed, a brighter sky fill than rain, whiter haze, soft contrast.

storm_sand._doc: Overlay for a sandstorm (desert masks only; not in Raza): a dim, ochre, dusty light - the sun dimmed and hidden, thick low brown haze, warm washed-out colours.

storm_interior._doc: Overlay for a building in a storm: less daylight through the windows (lightning still flashes them).

raza_afternoon._exposure_doc: Fixed exposure (min = max), as inside: the camera never adapts (and switches between moods at once: adaptation speed 100, else a fixed exposure still eases to the next value), so walking up to a wall or out of a building doesn't fade the light (2026-10-06, the user). Each key mood names its EV, chosen by bracketing against what auto exposure had settled on in wide views (look-dev mood_zz_ev_*, ev_*.png): afternoon -0.7, morning -1.2, dusk -2.5, night -5.7, each a little brighter than the match to soften close shade; the cycle blends them by hour.
raza_afternoon._doc: Late-afternoon sun raking across the Hall's long facades from the south-west, warm key against a cooler sky fill, light haze for depth. Shade floor: lumen_skylight_leaking keeps occluded corners from going black, local exposure lifts deep shade without flattening the sunlit areas; lamps and braziers (props.json) add warm pools.

raza_morning._doc: Early morning: low sun from the east-south-east, cool and hazy, a thin ground mist (fog dense near the ground, falling off fast with height, clear for the first 12 m; forward-scattering toward the sun) that softens the distance without hiding anything; long soft shadows across the square. Mist chosen 2026-10-05 over a fuller haze (look-dev mood_raza_morning_fogA/fogB).

raza_dusk._doc: Dusk: the sun just above the west wall, deep orange key and long shadows, the sky fading; the first windows lit.

raza_interior_day._doc: Inside a Raza building by day: no sun (the zone profile turns it off), the room's own lights, the painted windows lit with daylight (Collection WindowDaylight, scaled by the zone's daylight), a warm ambient floor so corners away from the lights stay readable (Lumen skylight leaking, tinted warm, over the sky light's constant lower hemisphere), a dusty haze that only the room's lights show up in (volumetric fog at density 0.3 with a near-black warm fog colour and the sky light mostly out of it: warm glows around the lamps, torches and candles, no grey veil; chosen 2026-10-05 from mood_zz_haze_* in look-dev, docs/adr/0005 "Hazy interiors"), and a fixed exposure (EV -1, chosen by bracketing: mood_raza_interior_day_ev*), as the original renders at a fixed brightness: the room light itself dims at night instead of the camera adapting it away.

raza_interior_night._doc: Inside a Raza building at night: the windows dark, the room lit by its own lights over a dimmer warm ambient floor, exposure allowed to go darker.

raza_crypt._doc: The Mausoleum (ADR 0003 mood target: cold, high contrast, torch-lit): no daylight, a cold dim ambient floor, a faint cold mist that the torches and braziers glow in (the interiors' haze), desaturated cool grading with strong contrast; braziers and lights give the warm pools.

raza_night._doc: Night: cool moonlight (moods.json sky), the town lit by its lamps, braziers and glowing windows; a sky-light fill (intensity 1.0, skylight leaking 0.18; 2026-10-06, after the zone meshes got two-sided distance fields and Lumen could light walls with the sky at all: night_fill2.png) keeps shade readable instead of black; exposure allowed to go dark but kept below full adaptation so night reads as night.
